serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Specset is the AI platform for high-stakes construction. The Specset Cloud Platform automates technical review across Project Manuals, Drawing Sheets, and Shop Drawings — including submittal review against project specifications, UFGS compliance checking, design review automation, and asset management logic — flagging potential issues and delivering fast, accurate answers across project documents in seconds.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Specset Trust Center. The landing page, compliance posture summary, and FedRAMP milestone information are publicly viewable without authentication.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page at https://trust.specset.com is publicly accessible with no login. Certain detailed compliance documents require submitting an access request directly on the page; requests are reviewed promptly by the Specset security team (security@specset.com). All information required by FedRAMP CDS-CSO-PUB is published without authentication at https://specset.com/fedramp/ and https://specset.com/fedramp/fedramp.json.
